scope: Partial music panel interaction regression verification
result: Seek drafts are bound to the current session and queue entry, preventing an old drag from seeking a replacement track. Queue drag operations are rejected when the session or revision changes; cancelled drags are cleared. Related suites passed 41 and 42 tests respectively, with lint and TypeScript checks.
search_follow_up: Search prevents simultaneous duplicate submissions and discards responses from a previous query or closed panel. Related suites passed 47 and 49 tests respectively, with lint and TypeScript checks.
limitations: This is client regression evidence, not real multi-client audio or packaged release acceptance.
